title: Token file
description: A design-token source file under tokens/. Token files are JSON objects and are the single source of truth for values. Metadata keys are prefixed with '$'. Shapes vary by tier (primitive ramps, semantic role arrays, or scale configs), so the schema validates the envelope, not every value.
$comment: A token file must be a JSON object (never an array or scalar). It may be empty ({}) when a category is planned but not yet defined. Values live here and nowhere else — MDX may reference token names but must not restate values.
